questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: A cement factory grinds limestone all day, and the dust that settles on the land around it slows down one soil process; name that process. (A) the formation of soil upto a few cm in depth (B) the development of various types of soils (C) the infiltration of water into the soil (D) the weathering of parent rock material

answerScheme.modelAnswer: the infiltration of water into the soil

evidence:

limestone for cement industry and calcite and
soapstone for ceramic industry generate huge
quantity of dust in the atmosphere. It retards
the process of infiltration of water into the soil

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: While digging a well, a student finds that the material being dug changes at four different depths. (a) Name the four layers of the soil profile in the order in which they are met, from the surface downwards. (b) State what each of those four layers is made of.

markingPoints.description: Top soil, the upper soil layer
Subsoil, made of weathered rocks, sand and silt and clay; Substratum, made of weathered parent rock material
Unweathered parent bed rock, the bottom layer

answerScheme.modelAnswer: From the surface downwards: Top soil, which is the upper soil layer; Subsoil, made of weathered rocks, sand and silt and clay; Substratum, made of weathered parent rock material; and Unweathered parent bed rock, the bottom layer.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: A government has to plan the repair of damaged land and must first decide which human activity is causing the damage where. In steps, (a) name the human activities that have contributed significantly in land degradation, (b) state which one of them lies behind the severe land degradation in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha and what has caused it there, (c) name the states where over irrigation, and not overgrazing, is responsible for land degradation, and (d) state the two changes that over irrigation brings about in the soil.

markingPoints.description: Names deforestation, over grazing, mining and quarrying as the human activities responsible.
Names Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha.
States that deforestation due to mining has caused severe land degradation in those states.
Names Punjab, Haryana and western Uttar Pradesh as the states where over irrigation is responsible.
States that over irrigation causes water logging, which then increases the salinity and alkalinity of the soil.

answerScheme.modelAnswer:
Step 1: The human activities are deforestation, over grazing, mining and quarrying.
Step 2: Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha.
Step 3: There, deforestation due to mining has caused severe land degradation.
Step 4: Punjab, Haryana and western Uttar Pradesh are the states where over irrigation is responsible.
Step 5: Over irrigation causes land degradation due to water logging, and the water logging leads to an increase in salinity and alkalinity in the soil.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem:
A cement plant in Madhya Pradesh grinds limestone all day and a ceramic unit nearby grinds calcite and soapstone. Both send huge quantities of dust into the air, and the dust settles on the land around them. Farmers report that once the dust has settled, rain water no longer soaks into the soil but runs off instead. Elsewhere in the state a mine has been shut after excavation work was complete, and the site is left with deep scars and traces of over-burdening. In the same state, deforestation due to mining has caused severe land degradation, and overgrazing is one of the main reasons for land degradation in Madhya Pradesh as well as in Gujarat, Rajasthan and Maharashtra.

(a) Name the two industries whose mineral processing sends this dust into the air over the farmland. (b) Once the dust has settled on the land, explain which soil process it retards and what this means for the rain falling on the farmer's field.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: (a) The cement industry, which grinds limestone, and the ceramic industry, which grinds calcite and soapstone. (b) The dust retards the process of infiltration of water into the soil, so rain water no longer soaks into the soil and runs off the field instead.

soapstone for ceramic industry generate huge
quantity of dust in the atmosphere. It retards

the process of infiltration of water into the soil
after it settles down on the land.
